unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: We could not complete that. Please try again.

notFound: We could not find what you were looking for.
forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
noCooperativeAccess: You do not have access to this cooperative.
originNotAllowed: This website is not allowed to use the CoopManage service.
validationFailed: Some of the information is not valid. Please check the highlighted fields.
malformedJson: The request could not be read. Please try again.
conflict: That change conflicts with something already saved.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
databaseUnavailable: We cannot reach the database at the moment.
networkUnavailable: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

page.notFoundBody: The page you asked for does not exist, or it has moved.
page.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
page.forbiddenBody: Your role does not cover this part of the system. Ask your cooperative manager if you need it.
page.forbiddenBodyWithPermission: This page needs the "{{permission}}" permission, which your role does not include. Your cooperative manager can grant it.

boundary.title: This screen could not be displayed
boundary.body: The rest of the application is still working. You can go back to the dashboard or try loading this screen again.

tokenExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
invalidCredentials: That email address and password do not match an account.
accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
resetTokenInvalid: This reset link has expired or has already been used. Please ask for a new one.
